familyFindings.topsReplacement: Tops 1-6 replacement hashes materially fix the legacy flat-vector construction and are accepted. Tops 7-8 replacement hashes remain too flat/vector-like and require another version.
familyFindings.facegearLegacy: All 12 Facegear identities are readable, but the legacy family remains icon/vector-like with insufficient wearable/cosmetic depth, materials, reflections and higher-tier construction.

facegearReviews.name: Reader Glasses
facegearReviews.reason: Clear reader-glasses identity, but ultra-flat line art. Add frame thickness, hinges/temples, lens transparency/reflection and a wearable three-quarter angle.

facegearReviews.name: Heart Shades
facegearReviews.reason: Heart-shades identity reads, but lenses/frame are flat graphic shapes. Add molded thickness, arms/hinges, glossy translucent lenses, reflections and side depth.

facegearReviews.name: Gamer Visor
facegearReviews.reason: Visor identity is clear, but the broad front panel is icon-flat. Add curved visor volume, support hardware, lens depth, reflections and controlled emissive response.

facegearReviews.name: Sparkle Freckles
facegearReviews.reason: Sparkle freckles read as floating star stickers rather than integrated cosmetics. Add believable face-placement/material cues with subtle sparkle depth and skin-adjacent lighting.

facegearReviews.name: Petal Paint
facegearReviews.reason: Petals are flat floating decals and Galaxy Glow is weak. Add cosmetic surface integration, layered pigment/material depth and a specific galaxy-light treatment.

facegearReviews.name: Star Shades
facegearReviews.reason: Star-shades identity is strong but frame/lenses remain flat. Add frame/lens thickness, temple arms/hinges, reflection/refraction and molded Sunny Pop material response.

facegearReviews.name: Smile Specs
facegearReviews.reason: Smile Specs are recognizable but icon-like. Add true frame hardware/depth, tinted lens material/reflection and wearable perspective.

facegearReviews.name: Bubble Frames
facegearReviews.reason: Bubble-frame silhouette reads, but transparent circles remain 2D and Art Attack is background-led. Add translucent bubble-lens volume, frame thickness/reflections and stronger art-specific material/detail.

facegearReviews.name: Splatter Cheeks
facegearReviews.reason: Splatter Cheeks read as floating colored decals rather than premium face paint. Add cosmetic/paint integration, pigment/material variation, placement depth and stronger Star Luxe treatment.

facegearReviews.name: Lightning Glasses
facegearReviews.reason: Lightning identity is strong, but Tier 4 remains a flat emblem. Add frame/lens thickness, temples/hinges, sculpted lightning geometry and controlled Midnight Neon emission/rim lighting.

facegearReviews.name: Gem Frames
facegearReviews.reason: Gem-frame concept is readable but flat. Tier 4 needs faceted gem settings/refraction, true frame depth, hardware and richer Candy Core material response.

facegearReviews.name: Star Mask
facegearReviews.reason: Star-mask identity is readable, but Tier 5 is still a flat emblem. Add sculpted shell thickness, strap/support construction, layered materials and richer Adventure Club hero lighting/detail.

replacementReviews.name: Hoodie
replacementReviews.reason: Dimensional hoodie with clear hood/body/sleeve volume, soft fabric folds and controlled lighting while preserving a simple starter identity.

replacementReviews.name: Zip Hoodie
replacementReviews.reason: Three-dimensional zipper/hardware, hood-body separation and fabric volume resolve the legacy defect; Pixel Party motif remains card-readable.

replacementReviews.name: Varsity Tee
replacementReviews.reason: Sleeves, collar and torso show convincing volume/folds and the berry/lightning treatment remains readable without overloading Tier 1.

replacementReviews.name: Bow Cardigan
replacementReviews.reason: Real cardigan/knit volume with layered bow, floral/button/cuff construction and soft dimensional lighting appropriate to Tier 2.

replacementReviews.name: Crewneck
replacementReviews.reason: Constructed sweatshirt volume, folds/ribbing and galaxy material-light treatment provide the missing dimensionality.

replacementReviews.name: Gamer Jacket
replacementReviews.reason: Layered collar/panels, seams/hardware and dimensional sleeves fix the flat panel look while gamer identity and Sunny Pop accents remain distinct.

replacementReviews.name: Colorblock Hoodie
replacementReviews.reason: Still a flat frontal vector hoodie. Identity/theme read, but Tier 3 lacks convincing fabric volume, folds, material response, three-quarter construction and cast/contact lighting.

replacementReviews.name: Puffer Vest
replacementReviews.reason: Vest silhouette is distinct, but quilt/puffer regions remain flat graphic bands with weak loft/material depth and weak Art Attack storytelling.

08.note: These six replacement hashes are independently accepted from actual hash-bound card/detail pixels and are eligible for canonical integration after Workstream 08 metadata/file/content/safety checks. No second universal visual approval is required.

repairs.reason: Replacement hashes still fail the dimensional/material target; preserve them and create a new version.
All legacy Facegear hashes are REWORK; assign bounded versioned repairs to a producer other than reviewer 01.

handoff.next01Review: Base partition is now 48/48 reviewed. Fresh replacement hashes for Tops/Bottoms/Headwear/Facegear take priority on future runs; do not redo accepted Tops 1-6 unless their hash changes.
